text_block_list.text:
I notice a lot of people gathering around
the
track as I'm walking by.
Pipe down. The race is about to start.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...The president sent me out here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We're holding a public relations event to
teach
people who've never seen a race
what it's all
about.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I don't see why I have to host it,
though...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're gonna run too, right?! I'll be
cheering
for you!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text: Not necessary. Just shut up and watch.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Oh... I-I see... Sorry...
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text: And?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Wow... That's so rude. I can't believe a
bully like
you is running!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
I thought racers found their fans' support

motivating. You should be grateful to
even have
any fans with that attitude.
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text: ...Let 'em chirp all they want.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Huh?! I'm trying to talk to you and you call it chirping?! That's it, I'm going ho—Agh!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text: Thud.
Are you all right?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Leave me alone! It's just a light sprain—
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text: Shush. Turn your shoulder this way.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
There's no swelling, so I just taped it up.
...Does it
hurt?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: No. ...You're really good at that.
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
I'm very careful when it comes to injuries.
I don't
want to miss any races.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Plus...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
If there are people out there who would
support
someone like me, then I
wouldn't want to worry
them.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...All I want is for them to watch my back
as I blow
by.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...!
S-so... coool!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
...What are you gawking at?! Go to the
hospital
already!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Unless you want this "bully" to carry you
there?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ah! N-no, that's okay! I don't think my
heart could
take it!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you for everything! I'll be sure
to make
a full recovery and come cheer
you on!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
Cheer me on? ...Didn't she hate my guts
a second
ago?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Maybe she realized how cool you were.
You must've impressed her with your work!

text_block_list.text:
Cheer me on? ...Didn't she hate my guts
a second
ago?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Maybe she realized how cool you were.
You must've impressed her with your work!

text_block_list.text:
Cool? ...Now I'm even more lost. They're
scared of
me, yet they admire me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Is it like some kind of... infatuation or

something like that?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Wipe that smile off your face.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You think so? ...I'm not sure I really
fulfilled my
duty as the host.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: No, you've been splendid.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I can only hope you'll keep up the good
work.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: What the... What the heck...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Even with Нарита Брайан staring me down, I
can't
help but chuckle.

After that, Нарита Брайан continues to gain
fans
without quite knowing why.
